candidates.change_summary: Replace the withdraw call so it transfers 0 instead of the full balance.
Delete the withdraw call so withdrawAll performs no transfer.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can drain the contract via withdrawAll.
Delete the `_ ;` statement so the modified function body never executes (reverts are avoided, the guarded function becomes a no-op check).
Remove the transfer statement so withdraw(uint256) sends no Ether.
Send the contract's entire balance instead of the _value parameter.
Send the funds to the zero address instead of the caller.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners may pass the modifier.
Remove the ownership requirement so anyone passes the modifier.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from sendMoney so any caller can execute it.
Delete the require(__sent_result100) check so sendMoney no longer reverts when the low-level call fails.
Replace the require(msg.sender==owner) check with require(true) so the onlyOwner modifier imposes no restriction.
Delete the call to withdraw so withdrawAll performs no transfer of the contract balance.
Replace withdrawal of the full balance with withdrawal of a fixed amount of 1 wei.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can drain the balance via withdrawAll.
Invert the owner check so the modifier permits any caller except the owner.
Delete the require statement so the modifier imposes no restriction.
